hints.title: Transition Limitations
hints.text: Notice that 'AA' and 'BB' must alternate with one another, while 'AB' can be inserted freely.

hints.title: Alternating Chains
hints.text: We can pair up 'AA' and 'BB' tokens, with at most one extra token of the larger group.

hints.title: Closed Form Length
hints.text: Combine twice the minimum count of 'AA' and 'BB', plus one if they differ, plus all 'AB' tokens.

hints.title: Mathematical Formula Code
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def longestString(self, x: int, y: int, z: int) -> int:
        pairs = min(x, y)
        extra = 1 if x != y else 0
        return (2 * pairs + extra + z) * 2
```

complexity.notes: Closed-form arithmetic evaluates optimal token usage directly.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of strings wastes time when transitions form an algebraic upper bound.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the alternating property of 'AA' and 'BB' and uses closed form.
